missingRequestedView: 10-t18 is absent; inspected10-t8 plus10-t35 and10-t53 instead.
findings: At8-t18 and8-t35 the new shading separates overlapping lobes and gives both the stem and mushroom head visible volume. It is a clear improvement over the prior flat brown silhouette.
The main plume remains centered over and visually connected to the excavation mouth. No detached puff mass or smoke emitted through an outer landmark was observed in these frames.
At8-t35 the plume is still dense and partly covers the Hatchery, consistent with the blast peak. At8-t53 it is completely absent: no opaque cover lingers.
The finishing-blast dust is below the mouth at10-t8, visible low inside the opening at10-t35, and absent at10-t53. No detached or lingering finish plume was observed.
limits: The smoke remains a stylized collection of faceted billows, not a physically simulated volumetric effect.
Sparse still-frame comparison cannot establish every intermediate transition, transparency sorting from other cameras, low-quality appearance or performance.
Scene differences outside the dust exist between the older comparison frames and release frames; this review attributes only the visible shading/readability difference to the material change.
No source, timing, geometry or material was edited by the reviewer; only this report was written.
